## 📡 Signal Search · Beta 2

> Same control room. Cleaner signals.

The second Signal Search field build brings New Eridu Proxy up to **v2rayN 7.25.6**, including mainline fixes through `95f438a`. This round focuses on safer updates, more reliable networking, and keeping every parallel route in its own lane.

## ✨ Dispatch highlights

- **Safer update extraction.** Archive entries that try to escape the application directory are blocked.
- **Guarded filters.** Subscription, policy-group, and log regex filters now have a timeout to prevent long-running matches from freezing their callers.
- **Independent sing-box caches.** Parallel nodes no longer compete for one cache database. Multiple sing-box listeners can stay online together.
- **Predictable LAN ports.** A parallel node uses its assigned mixed port even when an older global configuration requests a separate LAN listener.
- **Upstream network improvements.** MASQUE support, Xray TUN changes, DNS fixes, download cancellation, and latency/UDP test improvements are included.
- **Settings carried forward.** Existing prerelease preferences are migrated into the new per-core update selections.

Your familiar controls remain in place: **LAN access**, **Status**, **Mixed port**, **Live upload**, and **Live download** lead the node list. The traditional local mixed inbound stays on port `20808` and is disabled by default.

## 🧪 Field report

- **151 automated tests passed**, including regex timeouts and upgrade path containment.
- **Four real core processes verified together:** two Xray and two sing-box instances.
- Independent LAN binding, upload/download telemetry, daily/lifetime persistence, TCP/UDP conflict rejection, selected-node shutdown, and temporary configuration cleanup passed local smoke checks.
- Runtime checks use synthetic nodes and a local SOCKS server; no private subscriptions or real server credentials are involved.

## 🎛️ Operator checklist

1. Back up the existing `guiConfigs` folder before upgrading a portable installation.
2. Download `NewEriduProxy-windows-x64.zip` and verify it against the accompanying `.sha256` file.
3. Extract the complete folder and run `NewEriduProxy.exe` from that folder.
4. Start a few selected nodes and confirm their mixed ports, LAN policy, and traffic counters.

The release archive is built from a clean staging directory and contains no user nodes, subscriptions, logs, or traffic history.

This remains a beta. Full custom configurations are excluded from parallel startup. Enable LAN access only on trusted networks with appropriate firewall rules. When reporting an issue, redact credentials, UUIDs, subscription URLs, and private keys from logs and configuration files.

Built on the work of the v2rayN, Xray, sing-box, and v2fly communities. This unofficial fork is not affiliated with or endorsed by the v2rayN maintainers, HoYoverse, or COGNOSPHERE.

**Four routes checked. Control room standing by.**
